citation: Act of Aug. 10, 1917, ch. 53, sec. 24, 40 Stat. 276, 283 (Lever Act)
note: Termination section (provisions cease when the war with Germany terminated); basis of branch B13 (7 members). Read on the web only.

citation: Act of May 20, 1918, ch. 78, 40 Stat. 556-557 (Overman Act)
note: Duration proviso (p. 556) and termination paragraph reaching 'any authorization of the President under this Act' (p. 557); basis of B15, B16 and backstop for B06, B12 (the PDF covers pp. 556-557).

citation: Act of June 15, 1917, ch. 29, emergency shipping fund, 40 Stat. 182, 183
note: 'All authority granted to the President herein, or by him delegated, shall cease six months after a final treaty of peace is proclaimed'; basis of B14 (5 members).

citation: Treaty of peace with Germany, signed Aug. 25, 1921, proclaimed Nov. 14, 1921, 42 Stat. 1939
note: Proclamation date fixes the emergency shipping fund end (May 14, 1922) and bounds the Overman Act and war-keyed own terms.

citation: Treaty of peace with Hungary, signed Aug. 29, 1921, proclaimed Dec. 20, 1921, 42 Stat. 1951
note: Latest 1921 treaty proclamation; upper bound (June 20, 1922) for the Overman Act and EO 2929, and Dec. 20, 1921 for EO 2652.

citation: Joint Resolution of July 2, 1921, ch. 40, 42 Stat. 105-107 (Knox-Porter Resolution)
note: Declares the state of war at an end (secs. 1, 3) and retains enemy property (sec. 5); context for EO 2652 and the alien-property branch.

citation: National Archives, Guide to Federal Records, RG 63 (Committee on Public Information), administrative history
note: Dates the Committee's abolition to Aug. 21, 1919 under EO 3154; basis of B09 (4 members).

citation: National Archives, Guide to Federal Records, RG 182 (War Trade Board), administrative history
note: Board abolished effective June 30, 1919 under EOs 3059 and 3086-A as amended by EO 3099; basis of B11 and B12 (4 members).
Recites the Office of Alien Property's abolition by June 30, 1966; context showing no instrument ends WWI sale authorizations.

citation: Alien Property Custodian Report: proceedings under the Trading with the Enemy Act during 1918 and to Feb. 15, 1919 (1919)
note: Sale and rejection records for the 1918-1919 sale orders (B18). The Custodian's annual reports for 1919-1934 are needed for the 1920s orders: search HathiTrust for 'Annual report of the Alien Property Custodian'.

citation: 50 U.S.C. 4312 (Trading with the Enemy Act sec. 12), with the Act of Oct. 6, 1917, ch. 106, 40 Stat. 411 and the Act of Mar. 28, 1918 amendment
note: Current sec. 12 and its history: confirms the sale authority survives and no statute ended unexercised sale authorizations (B18, B19).

citation: Act of Mar. 4, 1917, ch. 180, eight-hour suspension proviso, 39 Stat. 1192
note: Authority for the eight-hour suspensions (B20); confirms it is a standing national-emergency power not reached by 41 Stat. 1359.

citation: Settlement of War Claims Act of 1928, Act of Mar. 10, 1928, ch. 167, 45 Stat. 254
note: Return of vested property to former owners; needed to show which unexercised sale authorizations became moot (B18). Citation as commonly given; page unverified until fetched.
